windowPickOnRecord: Window: you'll choose the app when recording starts
noWindows_desc: Open a window you want to record and it will appear here.
noCameras_desc: Connect or enable a camera to select it here.
micNotFound: Microphone not found. Connect a microphone and try again.
micDenied: Microphone access denied. Enable microphone permission and try again.
cameraNotFound: Camera not found. Connect a camera and try again.
cameraDenied: Camera access denied. Enable camera permission and try again.
chooseWindow: Choose a window to record and try again.
noDisplaySource: No display source is available yet. If you just enabled Screen Recording, wait a moment and try again.
cameraCaptureFailed: Camera capture failed. Continuing without camera track.
noMicsFound_desc: Connect or enable a microphone to choose it here.
systemAudioUnsupported_macosTooOld: System audio isn't recorded on this version of macOS (macOS 13 or later is needed). Only your microphone is recorded.
systemAudioUnsupported_linux: System audio isn't recorded on Linux yet. Only your microphone is recorded.
systemAudioUnsupported_platform: System audio can't be recorded on this system. Only your microphone is recorded.
recordingDisplayRemoved: The display you were recording was disconnected, so the recording stopped. Everything up to that point was kept.
